Single-group longitudinal workplace HIIT + calorie restriction intervention.

Nonrandomized controlled pretest-posttest study of 48 Korean male workers with MetS. BEST and education comparison groups were followed for 16 weeks; objective cardiometabolic outcomes were analyzed with group-by-time effects. No repeated outcome measurements beyond one pretest and one posttest, and follow-up completeness requires confirmation.
